ordinals.summary: Brevity/language drift mitigated by tighter chat token cap and removal of an example that acted as unintended language-switch instruction.
Found dynamic response-token allocator overriding chat policy and stale self-knowledge anchors; capped allocator by task policy and corrected grounding.
Sampling temperature became an explicit route request parameter with different chat/code defaults instead of a hidden adapter constant.
AI-assisted new-email composition added; fallback identity explicitly forbids pretending unexecuted actions or inventing unavailable data.
Persistent email signature and focus-force fixes expose WM/focus behavior as part of real effect usability rather than model semantics.
Removed deprecated wallpaper/wake-word references and corrected persistent-memory/email/voice self-knowledge; demonstrates topology drift invalidating hard-coded identity text.
Email hardening fixed missing search endpoint, header sanitation, regex false positives, UI-thread/race issues and nonblocking undo-delete.
Installer binary missing bundled dependency and clone bootstrap could recurse/fail; clean-VM install was source-reported as 14/14 steps, 13 services, 0 failures.
Hover handler destroyed read/unread visual state and delayed layout required explicit scroll stabilization.
Email moved IMAP-first with local fallback, retry/backoff, graph-based thread identity, persistent outbox, attachments, undo-delete and bulk-rate limiting.
Search input required explicit focus handling under overrideredirect window semantics.
Added overlay heartbeat freeze detection/restart plus email search/thread/manual credential path and clearer send-fallback feedback.
Clean Ubuntu installation exposed missing native build dependencies for dbus-python; installer dependency closure was incomplete.
Email configuration became provider-agnostic with provider-specific folder mapping, dynamic SMTP host and multi-account persistence.
Reply-All control removed; preserved as surface-history only, no architectural credit.
Email drafting prompt hardened against translation/meta/disclaimer leakage, showing output-format constraints need explicit validation rather than prompt assumption.
